skills.name: So Exciting!
skills.description: Has fun watching cartoons with her plushie penguin. Good effects on allies.  *Allies' Skill Range +30% (9 sec) *Resets the Skill cooldown of some allies.  *Removes allies' debuffs (7 sec)

skills.name: Star Catch Arrow!
skills.description: Throws a ball hard at the ground, bouncing up. Bad effects on enemies.  *Cancels enemy invincibility skills  *Applies charm effect to 2 enemies within range. (10 sec)

abilities.name: Group: SPYxFAMILY
abilities.description: SPYxFAMILY Tie-Up! Put Rangers of a group into a Team and HP buffs will be applied in battle. You must have a Team of at least 2 Rangers for group buffs to apply. The more Rangers you have in a Team from the same group, the stronger the buffs will be. (There are 5 buff levels.)

abilities.name: Deployment Freeze
abilities.description: Gives a high chance that 1 Ranger on the opposite team will have the time until it can be redeployed frozen for a fixed amount of time when a Ranger with this Ability is deployed. Activates 10 seconds after the battle starts.
